headline: UK Reapproves Major North Sea Jackdaw Gas Field After Legal Battles
summary: The UK government has officially re-approved the Jackdaw natural gas field 150 miles east of Aberdeen following years of legal challenges from environmental campaigners.
why: North Sea oil and gas infrastructure is vital for the United Kingdom's domestic energy security and independence.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Regulatory approval for offshore fields enables long-term fossil fuel production and supply additions.
